newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEDO buys Jan/Feb fuel oil to LG-Caltex at $105/T.
newsitem.headline: KEDO buys Jan/Feb fuel oil to LG-Caltex at $105/T.

text.p: The Korean Peninsula Energy Development Organisation (KEDO) has awarded its import tender to buy residual fuel oil for late January or early February arrival at $105 per tonne cost-and-freight North Korea to South Korean refiner LG-Caltex, a company source said on Friday.
The tender which closed January 22, sought 20,000 tonnes for discharge at Nampo, Songrim or Sonbong, and the remaining 22,000 tonnes to Sonbong, North Korea.
KEDO last tendered for residual fuel for November 10-29 delivery but cancelled the tender without giving a reason.
KEDO, an international organisation established to implement nuclear non-proliferation in North Korea, has agreed to supply the country with 500,000 tonnes of fuel oil annually.
